realization_ratio_formula: observed decode saving / summed local saving when denominator>0
summed_local_saving_formula: sum(control selected up_proj timing - intervention selected up_proj timing), run-aligned

system_labels.COVERAGE_SCALING_LOCAL_BUT_NOT_SYSTEMIC: N28 whole-decode benefit not materially positive, but >=50% selected N28 layers are MATERIAL_LOCAL
system_labels.COVERAGE_SCALING_NOT_SUPPORTED: N28 whole-decode benefit not materially positive and <50% selected N28 layers are MATERIAL_LOCAL
system_labels.COVERAGE_SCALING_POSITIVE_BUT_SUBTHRESHO: 0 < N28 whole-decode benefit <2% and > combined dispersion
system_labels.COVERAGE_SCALING_SYSTEM_RELEVANT: N28 whole-decode benefit >=2% and > combined dispersion

target_share_formula: sum selected control up_proj timing / control decode-step timing, run-aligned
